meta.description: Compares access and trunk port behavior.

question.text: A switch connects to an IP phone and a workstation, while another switch link must carry traffic for multiple VLANs. Select two accurate statements.
options: An access port normally carries traffic for one data VLAN
A trunk can carry traffic for multiple VLANs
A trunk port can never use VLAN tags
An access port automatically routes between VLANs
correctAnswers: An access port normally carries traffic for one data VLAN
A trunk can carry traffic for multiple VLANs
